landing.journey.request.label: Request
landing.journey.request.title: The environment you need, in your team’s terms.
landing.journey.request.body: Choose a project and define the roles of the people working together. Include the required image, compute size, network, and scope of data access in a request to establish the starting point for your research environment.
landing.journey.request.item1: The project defines the boundaries of resources and permissions.
landing.journey.request.item2: View and change permissions are separated by member role.
landing.journey.request.item3: The request records requirements for both the runtime environment and the data to connect.
landing.journey.request.caption: Define the project and roles, and bring the environment requirements together in one request.
landing.journey.allocate.label: Allocate
landing.journey.allocate.title: Resources connect within policy.
landing.journey.allocate.body: Check project quotas and resource-specific usage policies, then create a VM. Apply network and security rules and connect the permitted scope of shared data to configure an environment for the team.
landing.journey.allocate.item1: Checking quotas and policies does not mean creation has succeeded or capacity has been reserved.
landing.journey.allocate.item2: Track the progress of VM creation and network connections.
landing.journey.allocate.item3: Connect shared data to authorized projects and members.
landing.journey.allocate.caption: After policy and quota checks, the VM, network, and shared data are connected.
landing.journey.observe.label: Observe
landing.journey.observe.title: See relationships and changes, beyond the list.
landing.journey.observe.body: Read VM and network connections in the topology and examine usage through the available resource metrics. Review activity records alongside them to follow the context of changes, including who requested which operations.
landing.journey.observe.item1: The topology shows where resources are connected.
landing.journey.observe.item2: Interpret metrics alongside their retrieval time and the resource state.
landing.journey.observe.item3: Review change history while distinguishing activity records from operation results.
landing.journey.observe.caption: Read connections, resource metrics, and activity records together to understand changes in the environment.
landing.journey.reuse.label: Reuse
landing.journey.reuse.title: An environment built once becomes the next starting point.
landing.journey.reuse.body: Preserve a prepared runtime environment as an immutable layer or take snapshots of the resources you need. Start the next environment from a preserved version and build new changes separately, reducing repeated setup while keeping the original intact.
landing.journey.reuse.item1: Immutable layers preserve versions of a finalized runtime environment.
landing.journey.reuse.item2: A snapshot captures a resource at a point in time; it is not a backup.
landing.journey.reuse.item3: Keep new changes in a reused environment separate from the original layer.
landing.journey.reuse.caption: Reuse an immutable layer or snapshot as a starting point, and build new changes separately.
landing.journey.heading: The research environment journey
landing.journey.illustrationNote: The stages, resource configurations, and metrics in this diagram are illustrative examples. They do not represent actual allocation results or service status.
